intro: A Fishy Peril is a short dispatch quest tasked by Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire. Disturbed by reports of amphibious predators encroaching on the waterways, Remy sends travelers to alert Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. The errand highlights the strained resources of Stormwind's local garrison in responding to emerging wilderness threats.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend Briarthorn, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest! Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!
I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits. He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.
Please, friend Briarthorn, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.
Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
